results.title: Inside 'Crystal Lake Memories'
results.overview: A dark secret from Pamela Voorhees' past emerges after her son's death, just as bodies begin turning up across the quiet town of Crystal Lake.

results.title: Polyphem
results.overview: Polyphem is the second chapter in a series of short experimental landscape films that reinterpret the stages of the journey of Homer‘s Odyssey and set them in the context of the anthropocene. Filmed in the only active bauxite tailings pond in Germany, Polyphem reimagines the myth of Polyphemus from Homer’s Odyssey within a contemporary landscape scarred by red mud, industrial aluminium waste.

results.title: That Friend
results.overview: Paul, “That Friend” who turns one drink into a full-blown bender, crashes his best friend Henry’s romantic weekend with his new girlfriend Penny, only to unleash chaos when his drug-laced cigarettes disappear into a stranger's hands.

results.title: Dulce Violencia (aka Sweet Violence)
results.overview: A family plans to murder their daughter’s killer after he is released from a twenty-year prison sentence. Still pleading innocence, the ex-convict tries to rebuild his life until the ghosts of the past return to haunt him

results.title: A Lifetime of Love
results.overview: Fang Yimiao is a 23-year-old woman standing at the fragile edge of her life. Xiang Taiyang is a reclusive and eccentric 60-year-old man who believes his time has already run out. In a modest rented house in Yong’an, two strangers at opposite ends of existence cross paths. What begins as a quiet coexistence slowly unfolds into a healing symphony about living, loving, and finding reconciliation with oneself and the world.

results.title: Red Running into Love
results.overview: Two Navajo teens find themselves in a meet cute that goes terribly wrong.

results.title: Dreadful Mother
results.overview: Victoria awakens with a broken arm in a country house after being kidnapped. A doctor and nun care for her, but as she gradually uncovers their secrets, she realizes things aren't what they seem.

results.title: How To Hide It
results.overview: A moment of weakness after a humiliating breakup leads Zahra, a young Muslim woman to play a forbidden lottery ticket. Her chance at escape becomes a spiritual crisis. While her coworker dreams of riches, she’s certain Allah is watching and waiting.

results.title: Hostile Architecture
results.overview: Without a place of their own, trans lovers Grace and Billy find intimacy in an extra-dimensional room; but just like the city outside, the room itself threatens to swallow them whole.

results.title: Night of Blindness
results.overview: The military junta seized parliamentary rule on September 12, 1980.  Hundreds of thousands of people have been arrested across the country and torture and executions continue. Leaders of various trade unions, associations and student organizations, who are being pursued by the intelligence services, are seeking ways to illegally leave Turkey's borders. Intelligence units are turning a blind eye to a pirate action to trap the leaders.  New film by Reis Çelik.
